subject: general
question: Shri Raj Kumar Arora, a 1990-batch IDAS officer, has recently assumed charge as the Financial Advisor (Defence Services) in November 2025. Prior to this, which key position did he hold?

options.text: Chief Controller of Accounts, Ministry of Finance

solution:
The correct answer is __**Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shri Raj Kumar Arora, a 1990-batch officer of the Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS), assumed charge as Financial Advisor (Defence Services) on 1 November 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prior position held: Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA), the senior-most accounting authority for defence finances.**
 
• **Extensive experience in defence acquisition, financial policy, accounting, audit, and budgeting.**
 
• **Has served in senior roles including Additional Secretary (UPSC), Finance Manager (Air) in MoD acquisition wing, and Director in Ministry of Finance.**
 
• **Has held finance leadership roles in Ordnance Factory Board and as Integrated Financial Advisor across Defence Accounts commands.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA)**__

 __
 
• The CGDA is the apex accounting authority for the Indian Ministry of Defence, responsible for maintaining defence accounts, auditing defence expenditure, and ensuring financial propriety in defence procurement and maintenance.
 
• Role includes formulation of accounting standards for defence services, overseeing payments, and liaising with service headquarters and Ministry of Finance.
 
 
 
• **Financial Advisor (Defence Services) (FADS)**__
 __
 
• FADS provides financial advice on defence budgeting, expenditure control, and acquisition projects to ensure efficient allocation and use of resources within the Ministry of Defence.
 
• Works closely with defence services, acquisition wings, and financial controllers to align fiscal policy with operational needs.
 
 
 
• **Indian Defence Accounts Service (IDAS)**__
 __
 
• IDAS is a central civil service responsible for the finance and accounts of the defence services, staffed through UPSC examinations and trained for defence-specific accounting, audit and financial management roles.
 
 
 
• **Relevant Experience of Shri Raj Kumar Arora**__
 
 
• His background spans defence acquisition finance, personnel management, and high-level administrative roles — all pertinent to the responsibilities of FADS.
 
• Previous role as CGDA directly precedes his appointment as FADS, demonstrating continuity in defence financial leadership.
